Aligned research still uses OFFLINE public environments: 10 fixed games at 900 seconds per arm or 25 fixed games at a scaled 7254 seconds. This formal candidate enumerates live gateway games with the original 31920-second solver budget.

Aligned research passes a global soft_end=now+arm_budget to bm.run; the 009 formal branch retains soft_end=None. Disabling the request_deadline patch does not remove this remaining global-cutoff difference.

Aligned research enables request logs and timing/scheduler diagnostics, flushes caches between arm processes, bounds worker drain, and skips blanket model precache. This candidate retains the original 009 formal logging, startup and solver behavior and installs none of those research helpers.

A single public A/B run, whether baseline-first or candidate-first, is mechanism evidence rather than a reliable hidden leaderboard gain estimate. Validate transfer with repeated or reversed-order comparisons and report remaining research/formal differences.
Exact row-runs enlarge tool output and may be truncated or ignored; successful installation, checkpoint continuation or GPU save smoke alone does not establish score gain.
